detail: "Ernst&Young Montenegro" Ltd Podgorica was selected as external auditor of the Central Bank of Montenegro's annual financial statements for 2025 through an open public procurement procedure, on the proposal of the bid-opening and evaluation commission accepted by the Audit Committee, under a three-year framework agreement, using the capacities of "Ernst&Young Ltd Belgrade", Serbia.
source_title: Summary of the Audit Committee Report for 2025 (Central Bank of Montenegro)

detail: Note 30 of the National Bank of Moldova's financial statements states that KPMG Moldova SRL is the Bank's auditor for the financial years 2024 and 2023 (the subsidiary's auditor being Baker Tilly Klitou and Partners SRL).
